description: Implementation of the OrderService interface for processing, managing, and calculating orders in an e-commerce system. Includes payment processing, total calculations, invoice generation, and order status management.

classes.name: OrderServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for handling order processing, totaling, invoice generation, and order management.

methods.name: addOrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Adds a status history record to an order.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Processes an order with payment and transaction details, updating order status and customer info.

methods.name: caculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of an order, including taxes, shipping, and handling.

methods.name: calculateShoppingCartTotal
methods.description: Calculates total prices for shopping cart items, updating individual item prices.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an order from the system.

methods.name: generateInvoice
methods.description: Generates a PDF invoice for the specified order.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves an order by its ID.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all orders associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore with criteria
methods.description: Lists orders for a store based on specific search criteria.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new order or updates an existing one.

methods.name: hasDownloadFiles
methods.description: Checks if the order has downloadable files associated with its products.
